title: Search jobs
intro: Your agent browses these job boards with your browser and looks for what fits your profile. It only reads: it never applies for you. What it finds lands in the Inbox.
unusable_one: {{count}} more job board is turned off. Turn it on in <to>Where to search</to>.
unusable_other: {{count}} more job boards are turned off. Turn them on in <to>Where to search</to>.
noneChosen: Choose at least one job board.

refine.hint: Just this once: your agent will use these instead of your saved searches. Your profile doesn't change.
refine.badText: Use only letters, numbers and simple signs (. , + # / & ( ) -).

recent.title: Latest found by your agent
recent.empty: It hasn't brought any jobs from the boards yet.

empty.title: No job boards to search yet
empty.body: Tell your agent where you usually search or add a job board yourself.
empty.configure: Choose job boards with my agent

others: Target companies and email alerts don't need launching: the app checks them on its own. Set them up in <to>Where to search</to>.
